details.summary:
Netravati Peak Monsoon Trek - A Scenic Escape into the Western Ghats

The Netravati Peak Monsoon Trek takes you into the green landscapes of the Western Ghats, where forest trails, open grasslands and rolling hills come together to create a rewarding trekking experience. The route offers scenic views throughout the journey, making it a memorable weekend escape from Bengaluru.

Located in the Chikkamagaluru region, Netravati Peak is a lesser-known mountain that has become increasingly popular with trekkers. During the monsoon, the surrounding landscape takes on a fresh green character, adding to the appeal of the trail and the journey towards the peak.

With its mix of natural surroundings and changing terrain, the trek offers a moderate challenge for those looking to spend a weekend away from the city. The 14 km trail combines adventure with the peaceful atmosphere of the Western Ghats.

sections.title: A Trek Through Green Hills & Open Landscapes
sections.body:
The trail moves through a varied landscape, taking you across forest sections and open mountain terrain before reaching the higher slopes of Netravati Peak. The changing scenery keeps the journey engaging from the base to the summit.

From the peak, the surrounding hills and countryside open up into wide views, giving you a rewarding perspective of the Western Ghats after the climb.

sections.title: Things to carry
sections.body:
Things to Carry for Netravati Trek Since Netravati is a monsoon-season trek, carrying the right essentials is important for a comfortable and safe journey.

[Must Carry]

• Small, strong backpack - preferably waterproof
• At least 2 litres of drinking water
• Comfortable trekking shoes with good grip
• Extra pair of socks
• Torch/headlamp with fresh batteries
• Extra pair of clothes for two days
• Polybags for carrying wet clothes
• Toiletries
• Portable charger or power bank
• Energy food such as chocolates, dry fruits, energy boosters and electrolyte drinks
• Personal snacks
• Personal medication, if required
• Original government-issued ID proof
• Xerox copy of Aadhar/Voter ID
• Sunglasses
• Sunscreen
• Camera (optional)
• Face mask and hand sanitiser
• Flip-flops for use around the campsite
• Raincoat
• Waterproof backpack cover Packing Tip Keep your backpack light and protect your belongings from rain. Avoid carrying unnecessary items during the trek.

sections.title: Trail guidelines
sections.body:
Netravati is a natural destination in the Western Ghats. Help preserve it for future travelers.

"Trek Responsibly. Respect the Hills."

• Follow your trek leader's instructions at all times.
• Follow Forest Department rules and restrictions.
• Stay with the group throughout the trek.
• Remain on the designated trekking trail.
• Do not litter.
• Carry all waste back with you.
• Avoid single-use plastic.
• Do not smoke or consume alcohol during the trek.
• Do not light fires or campfires.
• Do not disturb wildlife.
• Do not damage plants or natural surroundings.
• Be careful around steep, slippery and rocky sections.
• Avoid standing too close to edges while taking photographs.
• Wear appropriate trekking footwear.
• Stay hydrated throughout the trek.
• Take breaks whenever required.

• Avoid loud music that may disturb wildlife and fellow trekkers. "Leave Only Footprints. Take Only Memories."
